evals.prompt: 帮我对这台机器做一次完整的 Codex 环境体检，只检查不要修。包括 Brain 同步、hooks 和 tools、config.toml 与 shell PATH、Chrome DevTools MCP、skills、Jenkins、Aliyun CLI、Plane 和 glab。
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled doctor in full mode and reports configured, locally verified, remote verified, and runtime-exposed states separately.
expectations: Does not modify config, repositories, caches, hooks, or installed tools
Leads with failures and distinguishes PASS, WARN, FAIL, and UNKNOWN
Checks Aliyun profile readiness and read-only STS authentication without exposing credentials or identity output
Checks Brain tool inventory, syntax, executable bits, interpreters, imports, and local references without executing business tools

evals.prompt: 为什么 plane-cli 和 brain 在我自己的 zsh 里能用，Codex 里有时找不到？帮我定位 PATH 和 shell_environment_policy，先别改配置。
evals.expected_output: Compares the parent shell, configured Codex child PATH, and login-shell resolution without changing config.toml.
expectations: Checks both current command resolution and shell_environment_policy.set.PATH
Does not claim a fix was applied

evals.prompt: 确认 chrome-devtools MCP 和我本机的 skills 是真的可用，不要只告诉我已经写进 config 了。
evals.expected_output: Probes Chrome MCP process startup, MCP JSON-RPC initialization, tool inventory, and list_pages; validates skill discovery and integrity while keeping session exposure explicit.
expectations: Separates MCP registration, process startup, protocol handshake, and browser operation
Validates SKILL.md frontmatter, symlinks, duplicate names, and skill metadata pressure
Does not equate valid skill files with current-session exposure

evals.prompt: 检查 Jenkins 环境变量、Codex 和 login shell 是否继承、brain/tools/jenkins.sh 是否可用，并验证凭据能否调用 Jenkins API。不要打印任何凭据，也不要触发 job。
evals.expected_output: Separates workspace credential presence, Codex/login-shell inheritance, helper health, and read-only authenticated API usability without exposing values.
expectations: Uses --network for Jenkins whoAmI and root API checks
Reports variable names and presence only, never URL, username, token, Authorization header, or response body
Does not invoke any Jenkins build or deployment endpoint

evals.prompt: 检查 aliyun cli 的 PATH、配置和真实认证是否可用，同时检查 brain tools 是否完整可运行。不要输出 AK、账号身份，也不要执行任何线上查询、构建或部署工具。
evals.expected_output: Validates Aliyun CLI/config plus read-only STS authentication, and statically validates Brain tool inventory, integrity, and dependencies without exposing secrets or executing business entrypoints.
expectations: Uses --network for the read-only Aliyun sts GetCallerIdentity check and discards the response body
Never reports AccessKey values, account IDs, ARNs, profile names, or raw authentication errors
Runs brain tools list and static syntax/dependency checks without invoking production-query, build, deploy, or write operations
